comments: Visually reviewed against sources-1.png through sources-5.png on 2026-10-15.
Supplemental pieces retained as reviewed proposals; runtime selects existing states only.
Missing second flinch, registered damage variants for acting poses and terminal seam masks; retain coherent original bank. Final damage level cannot be substituted by a collapse.
DAMAGE-1 activates the matching design now that the supplemental recoil and collapse bank exists. Long cough poses stay staged; no separate attack rule exists.
geometry: Board cells and cracks own hits; no spatial boss hurtbox. Renderer::landing and draw own the exact slag destination; body art must not suggest a second attack area.
mapping_basis: Inspected source poses and manually measured transparent gutters; runtime names match existing renderer states.

source_preparation.warm_effect_grade: pale cores to 216/169/94; warm R<=208, G<=0.82R, B raised toward 0.30R within G

timing: Idle bobs 1 px each half of a 36-tick period. Damage at 12/24/36 cracks; two flinches divide the 8-tick clear at flash>4 / <=4. Two wind-ups divide tuned TELL=27 at windup/2; attacks rest 165/135/105 ticks by cracks phase. Cascades pause tell progression. No separate recovery timer (Board::step, crack_stage; renderer::draw).
